**Problem / use case**
What are you trying to do that rope doesn't support today?

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see. If it touches the C ABI, note that it must be additive
(see docs/ABI_POLICY.md).

**Alternatives considered**

**Scope**
- Which layer(s): core engine / C ABI / Flutter / Unity-Godot (C#) / Godot GDExtension / build.
- Real-time-safety implications, if any (audio-thread cost, allocations).
